answer.original_source: Wendell Weeks, Corning Chairman, CEO and President, quoted by Fox News Digital on 2026-07-01
answer.new_information: Weeks said Corning is in its fastest growth period and will probably double its size over the coming years, with almost all new hires in advanced manufacturing and a significant part in America. No date, base or definition is given for the doubling. The Fox article also repeats the NVIDIA-Corning three-facility project (more than 3,000 jobs in North Carolina and Texas, tenfold US optical capacity, no completion date) and the Wistron Texas supercomputer manufacturing item (no jobs figure or date). The record concerns Corning, not NVDA's own numbers, and the catalog and stored pieces are empty, so there is nothing to compare or revise.
answer.reason: No catalog questions, stored pieces, or questions_to_consider were supplied, so no question can be updated. The record is a party statement of undated growth intent by Corning plus a relayed partnership with no completion date and no job or capacity timing. That is context for NVDA, not a number that moves an existing argument. It does not carry a separate investment judgement that would justify a new question, so it is background only. The NVIDIA-Corning and Wistron items are relayed in a single Fox article with no independent confirmation in the texts, and the record is not a same-claim repeat of anything stored.
